summary: Lindblad Expeditions filed an 8-K disclosing that on September 14, 2026 its subsidiary entered a Purchase Agreement to acquire a 60% controlling interest in White Desert Ltd, PNR Airways Ltd and Echo Charlie Ltd, Antarctic expedition and aviation-based experiential travel operators, for roughly $61 million cash plus about $6 million for balance-sheet cash, subject to working-capital, cash and debt true-ups. Two options to buy the remaining equity in equal tranches within 30 days after December 31, 2030 and 2031, priced off EBITDA, were granted; employment agreements were signed with key employees and updated guidance issued.
